name: chatwork-archive-completion
description: Create Chatwork archive knowledge reports, upload them to Drive, and mark the matching CW archive sheet row complete.

interface.shortDescription: Chatworkアーカイブの分析、Drive格納、完了更新をまとめて実行します。
interface.longDescription: Chatwork room logs or CW archive sheet rows are processed into internal-knowledge Markdown reports, uploaded to the approved Google Drive folder, and verified against the matching spreadsheet row before setting completion to TRUE.
interface.defaultPrompt: CWアーカイブシートの行またはChatworkルームをもとに分析レポートを作成し、Driveに格納して完了管理シートの該当行をTRUEにしてください。
